column4: cleat#2649: MSSQL-only by nature, not by omission -- same reasoning as this directory's TestAwaitEventMarshalFailureLeavesEventUnconsumed entry, which it mirrors exactly: event_data is JSONB on Postgres and JSON on MySQL, and both dialects validate JSON syntax at INSERT and refuse this test's malformed literal before ClaimOrRegisterAwaiter ever runs. MSSQL's event_data is NVARCHAR(MAX), a plain text column with no such check. Checks os.Getenv via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectMSSQL) directly (no subtests), so it skips once, at the top level, in ci.yml's test-go/plugins job (PostgreSQL only via CLEAT_TEST_DB) and runs wherever CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is set. Measured: go test ./plugins/eventtriggers/... -run TestClaimOrRegisterAwaiterSkippingBeforeCommitLosesCleat2654IsRealFinding -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' with CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset reports exactly this one skip.
